fields.rt-blog-html:
"The restaurant industry is a business that can become eminently digital, eminently 3.0. and very advanced.

Jean Valfort, co-founder of Panorama Group

We are proud to present our 10th episode of "Restaurateurs of Tomorrow"! And who better than Jean Valfort, co-founder of Panorama Group, to celebrate this anniversary with us?

Restaurant owner, entrepreneur and visionary (the Dark Kitchens in France... that's him), he gives us his feedback and his sharp point of view on the debates that are shaking the restaurant industry.

Ceiling of meal tickets, treasury, polemic around the Parisian terraces, Jean is cash and we appreciate it.

Seated catering and various business models, the place of delivery, reopening, vision of the future of catering: take your headphones, you won't be disappointed!

Guest of the week

Did you like this episode?

Feel free to listen to our other episodes and rate our podcast on your favorite platform.
